f3_program: observe(at("mitchell.book.completed_chapters.count", "before_4_oclock"), 10, "count", source("had read ten chapters of a book before 4 o'clock"))
observe(at("mitchell.book.chapter_11.pages_read.count", "4_oclock"), 20, "count", source("had read 20 pages of the 11th chapter"))
same(at("mitchell.book.chapter_11.pages_read.count", "after_4_oclock"), at("mitchell.book.chapter_11.pages_read.count", "4_oclock"), source("she didn't read the remaining pages of chapter eleven"))
add("read_two_more_chapters_after_4", "mitchell", at("mitchell.book.completed_chapters.count", "current"), 2, source("read 2 more chapters of the book"))
observe(at("mitchell.book.chapter.pages.count", "current"), 40, "count", source("each chapter in the book had 40 pages"))
collection("ariana.past_due_bills", "bill", "ariana", source("past due on three bills"))

percent_of(at("ariana.past_due_bills.bill_1.simple_interest.amount", "each_overdue_month"), at("ariana.past_due_bills.bill_1.base_amount", "current"), 10, source("charges 10% simple interest for each overdue month"))
observe(at("ariana.past_due_bills.bill_2.late_fee.amount", "each_overdue_month"), 50, "dollar", source("charges a flat $50 late fee per month"))
observe(at("ariana.past_due_bills.bill_3.overdue.duration", "current"), 2, "month", source("last bill is two months late"))
observe(at("ariana.past_due_bills.bill_3.late_fee.amount", "first_overdue_month"), 40, "dollar", source("a $40 fee the first month overdue"))

multiple(at("ariana.past_due_bills.bill_3.late_fee.amount", "second_overdue_month"), at("ariana.past_due_bills.bill_3.late_fee.amount", "first_overdue_month"), 2, source("twice that fee the second month overdue"))
collection("contest.prize_winning_novels", "novel", "publishing_house.contest", source("the 18 novels with the most votes"))
observe(at("contest.prize_winning_novels.count", "current"), 18, "count", source("18 novels with the most votes"))
observe(at("contest.prize_pool.amount", "current"), 800, "dollar", source("a total of $800 in prizes"))
partition("contest.prize_winning_novels", at("contest.prize_pool.amount", "current"), source("will award a total of $800 in prizes to the 18 novels with the most votes"))

same(at("contest.prize_winning_novels.fourth_place_onwards.each.prize.amount", "current"), at("contest.prize_winning_novels.fourth_place_onwards.shared_prize.amount", "current"), source("the rest of the awards will be paid with the same amount of money"))
